title: Session Replay for Laravel: Self-Hosted Browser Recordings
content:
Session Replay records browser sessions in your Laravel app with rrweb, stores them on your own disk, and marks errors and failed Livewire requests.

The post Session Replay for Laravel: Self-Hosted Browser Recordings appeared first on Laravel News.
